summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py. It returns a new Graph with triples whose subject is the resource, follows blank-node objects recursively, includes reification statements for each included triple, and uses a seen set to handle cycles. Added three tests (testCBD, testCBDReification, testCBDCycle) to test/test_graph.py and a Concise Bounded Description section to docs/utilities.rst. Tests and doctests were not run, since the instructions prohibited running repository code; the changes were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed. requirements.txt (black) and CHANGELOG.md were left unchanged.
